Load the libraries and import the  data
```{r}
library(plyr)
library(rptR)
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(afex)
library(ggpubr)
library(predictmeans)
library(gridExtra)

#read in the master file with the data
data_iso <- readRDS('../data/NESE_RepeatData.rds')


#subset to just seals that have isotope data at arrival (no San Nic seals)
#includes ONLY seals at arrivel (and not after fasting) and only the seals that have been
#vetted for the isotopes paper (removes just a handful of seals for a variety of reasons)
Isotopes<-subset(data_iso,!is.na(d13C)&TimePeriod=="Arrival"&(MainID!="RG180"&MainID!="RG182"
  &MainID!="RG184"&MainID!="RG185"&MainID!="RG187"&MainID!="RG191"))

#total 304 samples
length(unique(Isotopes$animalID)) #from 304 unique seals, males and females (236 females)
rm(data_iso)
```

Identify repeat seals

```{r}
#identify.repeat.seals
summ.count.seals<-ddply(Isotopes,c("MainID","Sex"),summarise,
  n.samples=length(d13C))
summ.count.seals.repeat<-subset(summ.count.seals,n.samples>1)
a<-unique(summ.count.seals.repeat$MainID)

#subset Isotopes dataset into just repeat animals
RepeatIsotopes<-subset(Isotopes,MainID %in% a)
FemaleRepeatIsotopes<-subset(RepeatIsotopes,Sex=="Female")
ID<-unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID)
b<-unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID)

##############################################################################
#full datasets - no removal of individual datapoints (not pregnant, etc)
##############################################################################
##### Carbon
rptC.rep1F<-rpt(d13C ~ Trip + (1 | MainID), grname = "MainID", data = FemaleRepeatIsotopes,
                datatype = "Gaussian", 
                nboot = 10000, npermut = 0)

#print(rptC.rep1F)
summary(rptC.rep1F)
#plot(rptC.rep1F,cex.main=1)
#Checking assumptions - code from Liz McHuron
d13C.lmer<-lmer(d13C~ Trip+ (1|MainID), data=FemaleRepeatIsotopes) #Take ID Variance/Residual+ID
Anova(d13C.lmer)
plot(d13C.lmer) #maybe one outlier should check
hist(resid(d13C.lmer))
qqnorm(resid(d13C.lmer))
plot(d13C.lmer, sqrt(abs(resid(.)))~fitted(.), type=c("p","smooth"))

##### Nitrogen
rptN.rep1F<-rpt(d15N ~ Trip + (1 | MainID), grname = "MainID", data = FemaleRepeatIsotopes, datatype = "Gaussian", 
   nboot = 10000, npermut = 0)
#print(rptN.rep1F)
summary(rptN.rep1F)
#plot(rptN.rep1F,cex.main=1)
d15N.lmer<-lmer(d15N ~ Trip+ (1|MainID), data=FemaleRepeatIsotopes) #Take ID Variance/Residual+ID
Anova(d15N.lmer)
plot(d15N.lmer)
hist(resid(d15N.lmer))
qqnorm(resid(d15N.lmer))
plot(d15N.lmer, sqrt(abs(resid(.)))~fitted(.), type=c("p","smooth"))
```


```{r}

##### Individual female repeatability (Liz McHuron code)

all<-lapply(FemaleRepeatIsotopes[,c(10:11)], 
            function(x) lmer(x ~ Trip + (1|MainID),
                             data=FemaleRepeatIsotopes)) #Take ID Variance/Residual+ID            
summary(all$d13C)
summary(all$d15N)

#Extract residuals and calculate individual repeatability
tempresid<-data.frame(lapply(all, residuals))
tempresid$MainID<-FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID
variance<-ddply(tempresid, "MainID", function(x){
  apply(x, 2, var)})
variance$MainID<-ID
variance2<-data.table::melt(variance)

temp<-lapply(all, VarCorr)
temp.d13C <- data.frame(temp[["d13C"]])$vcov[1]
temp.d15N <- data.frame(temp[["d15N"]])$vcov[1]

temp.d13C.2 <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID)), ncol= 2)) #Create an empty matrix
temp.d15N.2 <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID)), ncol= 2)) #Create an empty matrix

colnames(temp.d13C.2) <- c('Variance','variable')
colnames(temp.d15N.2) <- c('Variance','variable')

temp.d13C.2$Variance <- temp.d13C
temp.d13C.2$variable <- 'd13C'

temp.d15N.2$Variance <- temp.d15N
temp.d15N.2$variable <- 'd15N'

temp2 <- rbind(temp.d13C.2,temp.d15N.2)


indiR <-temp2
indiR$MainID <-  variance2$MainID
indiR$value <-  variance2$value

indiR$indi<-indiR$Variance/(indiR$Variance+indiR$value) 

#between individual variability / (between individual variability + residual variance for each individual)
write.csv(indiR,file="../results/IndividualCN_Female_Repeatability.csv",row.names = F)
summary(indiR$indi[indiR$variable=="d13C"])
sd(indiR$indi[indiR$variable=="d13C"])
length(indiR$indi[indiR$indi>0.75&indiR$variable=="d13C"])
summary(indiR$indi[indiR$variable=="d15N"])
sd(indiR$indi[indiR$variable=="d15N"])
length(indiR$indi[indiR$indi>0.75&indiR$variable=="d15N"])
```

Create figures
```{r}
###### Individual repeatability
indiR<-read.csv("../results/IndividualCN_Female_Repeatability.csv",T,sep=",",stringsAsFactors = F)
a<-ggplot(indiR, aes(x=variable, y=indi))
A<-a + geom_boxplot(width=0.6, size=1,coef=20)+
  geom_point(pch=21,size=1.25,color="black",fill="gray80",position = position_jitter(w=0.04,h=0))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), axis.title=element_text(size=15),legend.key=element_blank(), 
        legend.title=element_blank(), legend.position=c(0.78,0.80),
        legend.text=element_text(size=15),
        axis.title.y=element_text(vjust=1,size=15),
        axis.text=element_text(size=15,color="black"),
        axis.text.y=element_text(angle=90, hjust=0.5,size=15),
        plot.title=element_text(face="bold"))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c((expression(paste(""*delta^13*"C"))),expression(paste(""*delta^15*"N"))))+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0.30,1),breaks=seq(0.3,1,0.1),labels=c("",0.4,"",0.6,"",0.8,"","1.0"))+
  ylab(expression(paste("Repeatability")))+
  xlab(expression(paste("")))+
  theme(panel.grid.major=element_line(colour=NA), panel.grid.minor=element_line(colour=NA))+
  theme(legend.key=element_rect(colour="white")) 

print(A)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/FemaleRepeatability.pdf",
       plot = A,
       device = cairo_pdf)

tiff("../figures/FemaleRepeatability.tiff", width=4, height=4,units="in",res=300)
grid.arrange(A, ncol=1,nrow=1)
dev.off()
```


```{r}
indiR2<-indiR[1:46,c(1,3:5)]
colnames(indiR2)<-c("Variance.d13C","MainID","value.d13C","indi.d13C")
indiR3<-indiR[47:96,c(1,3:5)]
colnames(indiR3)<-c("Variance.d15N","MainID","value.d15N","indi.d15N")
indiR4<-merge(indiR2,indiR3,by="MainID")
rm(indiR2,indiR3)

##############################################################################
#reorganize data frame
FemaleRepeatIsotopes<-FemaleRepeatIsotopes[order(FemaleRepeatIsotopes[,"ProcedureYear"]),] #order by sample year
FemaleRepeatIsotopes2=NULL
for(i in (b)){
  print(i)
  ind.seal<-FemaleRepeatIsotopes[FemaleRepeatIsotopes$MainID==i,]
  ind.seal$SampleNumber=seq.int(nrow(ind.seal)) #gives a row number for each sample
  FemaleRepeatIsotopes2<-rbind(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2,ind.seal)
  rm(ind.seal)
}
unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$SampleNumber)
str(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$SampleNumber)

#add a column for 'abnormality' for abnormal years
FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear<-NA
#PM14,15,16, PB14,15,16,17, PB2010,PM2010
trips<-c("PM2010","PM2014","PM2015","PM2016","PB2010","PB2014","PB2015","PB2016","PB2017")
FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear[FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$UniqueTrip %in% trips]<-"abnormal"
FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear[FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear!="abnormal"|is.na(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear)]<-"normal"
unique(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2$AbnormalYear)

FemaleRepeatSumm<-ddply(FemaleRepeatIsotopes2,c("MainID"),summarise,
    n.samples=length(d13C),
    n.complete.Track=sum(CompleteTrack,na.rm=T),
    n.complete.TDR=sum(CompleteTDR,na.rm=T),
    min.age=min(AgeDeploy,na.rm = T),
    min.year=min(ProcedureYear),
    max.year=max(ProcedureYear),
    pct.change.in.std.length=(max(StandardLength_cm)-min(StandardLength_cm))/min(StandardLength_cm)*100,
    sample.spread.years=max.year-min.year,
    n.trip.types=length(unique(Trip)),
    n.PM=length(d13C[Trip=="PostMolt"]),
    n.PB=length(d13C[Trip=="PostBreeding"]),
    n.abnormal.trips=length(d13C[AbnormalYear=="abnormal"]),
    n.normal.trips=length(d13C[AbnormalYear=="normal"]),
    mean.max.lat=mean(MaxLat_degrees,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.max.lat=(max(MaxLat_degrees,na.rm=T)-min(MaxLat_degrees,na.rm=T))/min(MaxLat_degrees,na.rm=T)*100,
    mean.min.lon=mean(MinLon_degrees,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.min.lon=(max(MinLon_degrees,na.rm=T)-min(MinLon_degrees,na.rm=T))/min(MinLon_degrees,na.rm=T)*100,
    
    mean.prop.CAC=mean(MesoEcoProportionCAC,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.prop.CAC=(max(MesoEcoProportionCAC,na.rm=T)-min(MesoEcoProportionCAC,na.rm=T))/min(MesoEcoProportionCAC,na.rm=T)*100,
    mean.prop.SubArc=mean(MesoEcoProportionSubArcticPac,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.prop.SubArc=(max(MesoEcoProportionSubArcticPac,na.rm=T)-min(MesoEcoProportionSubArcticPac,na.rm=T))/min(MesoEcoProportionSubArcticPac,na.rm=T)*100,
    mean.prop.NCPac=mean(MesoEcoProportionNorthCPac,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.prop.NCPac=(max(MesoEcoProportionNorthCPac,na.rm=T)-min(MesoEcoProportionNorthCPac,na.rm=T))/min(MesoEcoProportionNorthCPac,na.rm=T)*100,
    
    mean.dist.shelf=mean(MedianDistToContShelf_km,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.dist.shelf=(max(MedianDistToContShelf_km,na.rm=T)-min(MedianDistToContShelf_km,na.rm=T))/min(MedianDistToContShelf_km,na.rm=T)*100,
    mean.day.dives=mean(DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.day.dives=(max(DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T)-min(DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T))/min(DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T)*100,
    mean.night.dives=mean(DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T),
    pct.diff.night.dives=(max(DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T)-min(DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T))/min(DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m,na.rm=T)*100)

#make 3 factor to test based on the different trips
FemaleRepeatSumm$TripFactor<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$TripFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.trip.types==2]<-"Combo.PM.PB"
FemaleRepeatSumm$TripFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.trip.types==1&FemaleRepeatSumm$n.PB>0]<-"Only.PB"
FemaleRepeatSumm$TripFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.trip.types==1&FemaleRepeatSumm$n.PM>0]<-"Only.PM"
FemaleRepeatSumm$AbnormalFactor<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$AbnormalFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.abnormal.trips>0&FemaleRepeatSumm$n.normal.trips>0]<-"Combo.normal.abnormal"
FemaleRepeatSumm$AbnormalFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.abnormal.trips==0&FemaleRepeatSumm$n.normal.trips>0]<-"Only.normal.trips"
FemaleRepeatSumm$AbnormalFactor[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.abnormal.trips>0&FemaleRepeatSumm$n.normal.trips==0]<-"Only.abnormal.trips"

#fill in NA for seals with only 1 TDR record or Track for the pct diff
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.max.lat[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.min.lon[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.dist.shelf[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.day.dives[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.TDR<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.night.dives[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.TDR<2]<-NA

FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.prop.CAC[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.prop.SubArc[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA
FemaleRepeatSumm$pct.diff.prop.NCPac[FemaleRepeatSumm$n.complete.Track<2]<-NA

indiR.merge<-merge(indiR4,FemaleRepeatSumm,by="MainID")
write.csv(indiR.merge,file="../results/IndividualCN_Female_Repeatability_Wide_WithMetadata.csv",row.names = F)

#go to 2021_Isotopes_RepeatFemales_Metadata
#to run the stats on the individual repeatability in regards to diving/tracking/metadata in relation

```
